name: Outbox dead-letter growth
query: increase(sacco_outbox_dead_lettered_total[1h]) > 0 — any growth in the dead-lettered counter within the trailing hour.
notes: sacco_outbox_dead_lettered_total is an unlabeled counter — platform and tenant outbox tables share the same worker code path (app/core/outbox/worker.py), so this is one platform-wide series. Any increment means an event exceeded its max publish attempts and needs manual replay/investigation; it never decreases.
